horizon.browser.privacy_note: Discover uses minecraftserve.rs and the public Modrinth API. The services see your IP address, requested page and public tag filters; minecraftserve.rs also receives public version filters. Saved servers, notes, player names and search text stay local. You can disable online discovery in Settings. Each source is cached for 5 minutes, with at most one request per source per minute. Loaded servers are contacted directly for status checks. Modrinth images and modpacks are not downloaded. Entries are saved only when you choose Add server.
